title: Linking words

summary_es.en: Spanish joins words: la hora sounds like lahora.
summary_es.fr: L’espagnol enchaîne les mots : la hora sonne comme lahora.
summary_es.zh: 西班牙语会连读：la hora 听起来像 lahora。
summary_es.ja: スペイン語は語をつなげて発音します：la hora は lahora のように聞こえます。

tip_es: In normal speech Spanish does not leave gaps between words. A word that ends in a vowel and the next one that starts with a vowel are joined in one syllable: mi amigo, la hora, voy a ir. Practise saying each phrase as one flowing unit, not as separate words.
